reason: A per-reactor mutex removes metadata ABA, publish/arm and cancel/dequeue races without introducing private generation tags or per-operation descriptors. Reuse the existing Linux stream-join40-byte pthread mutex ABI.
contract: No mutex held across epoll_wait, Task wait or pthread_join.
Completion syscalls use per-call MSG_DONTWAIT; preserve MSG_NOSIGNAL.
All published table transitions are serialized; no one-operation-perregistration restriction.
Worker scans all matching ready operations and rearms union of remaining interests after scan.
After a post-publication rearm error, retained slots publish native error outcomes; never return the same buffer as submission failure.
